def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
    # Drop rows with invalid (negative or zero) Quantity
    df = df[df['Quantity'] >= 1].reset_index(drop=True)
    # Fix Region: strip extra spaces and normalize case
    df['Region'] = df['Region'].str.strip().str.title()
    return df

def answer(df):
    result = df.groupby('Category')['Price'].mean().to_dict()
    return result
